description: This file implements a gateway probing utility that tests connectivity and retrieves status information from a gateway URL, including handling authentication, timeouts, and detailed status fetching.

methods.name: clampProbeTimeoutMs
methods.description: Clamps the provided timeout value between minimum and maximum allowed values.

methods.name: formatProbeCloseError
methods.description: Formats a close event into a human-readable error string.

methods.name: probeGateway
methods.description: Performs a network probe to a specified gateway URL, optionally with authentication and detail level, returning status and latency information.
